title: AC1024 physical MLEADERSTYLE source-to-output and file-readback proof

implementation.summary: Added an immutable source snapshot for selected DWG-origin MLEADERSTYLE records. Finalization now rejects edits, deletion, duplication, or source-generation changes after OBJECTS emission. Added a physical source selector that binds both source identities and ACAD_MLEADERSTYLE dictionary keys to emitted records, compares represented body/string fields, verifies mapped parent/reactor roles and LTYPE/BLOCK_RECORD/STYLE target roles, checks the MLEADERSTYLE CLASS count, and freshly imports ASCII and Binary output.
implementation.failureBehavior: A late source-field mutation after OBJECTS emission is refused while preserving a preexisting destination sentinel. Owner-key alias and missing-key mutations are refused. Restoring the source permits corrected retry on the same adapter for both encodings.
implementation.fixturePolicy: Reused the existing local AC1024 DWG witness. The selector uses temporary output files and adds no DWG/DXF fixture.

sourceToOutput.dictionaryRoute: The unique NOD ACAD_MLEADERSTYLE entry resolves to a complete owner dictionary. Both source handles have unique owner keys and no dictionary aliases.
sourceToOutput.fields: Typed body and string streams match for both source records. Common identity, type, name, flags, parent, extension-dictionary state and reactor links match. Reactor EED is checked as the emitted ACAD_REACTORS group.
sourceToOutput.references: Each non-null group 340, 341, 342 and 343 reference resolves after readback to a unique record of the required LTYPE, BLOCK_RECORD, STYLE or BLOCK_RECORD role, respectively, with the same source target name.
sourceToOutput.classTable: Exactly one MLEADERSTYLE/AcDbMLeaderStyle CLASS row is present with instanceCount 2.

freshReadback.result: PASS for ASCII and Binary output, including source identity, typed fields, owner/key membership, reference roles, mutation refusal, destination preservation and corrected retry.

neighboringGeneratedWriterCtest.result: FAIL before MLEADERSTYLE output: extension-object graph preflight reports 'Layer TABLE control identity or LAYER membership is incomplete' for the generated DXF input. This test does not exercise the physical DWG selector.

validation.fullSuites: NOT_RUN; focused physical and field-domain selectors were used.

limitations: The physical output proof uses explicit partial DWG-read policy; it does not establish complete-document conversion or consumer semantics.
The strict-complete gate remains closed: the AC1024 census still reports 228 opaque callback views and zero retained correlation frames.
MLEADER entity output and unsupported MLEADERSTYLE fields remain refused. No support claims are promoted.
The generated writer-closure CTest failure remains visible and needs its LAYER TABLE control preflight issue resolved separately.

planImpact.completedActionRemoved: Physical qualification of both AC1024 MLEADERSTYLE records, owner/key identities, represented fields, reference roles, ASCII/Binary readback, refusal and retry.
planImpact.nextAction: Qualify the 54 physical AC1024 ACDBASSOCGEOMDEPENDENCY identities and their source-backed fields/action/owner/reference roles in emitted output and fresh readback.
